lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: By first light the forest thins, and the river road runs on alone.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: No horns. The others drop where they stand and sleep in the ferns.

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: They chose the road. Let them walk it.

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: North of here is a fort that nobody holds. Someone there carries one of us. I can taste the iron.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: {mc} does not tell the others what the sword said. Not yet.
